hikes.name: Ice Lake
hikes.blurb: Up the West Fork past Adam Creek's long falls to a turquoise lake under the Matterhorn's white marble.

hikes.name: Lakes Basin via Two Pan
hikes.blurb: Up the East Lostine's meadow valley into the Wallowas' famous basin of granite lakes under Eagle Cap.

hikes.name: Eagle Cap
hikes.blurb: The long day to the hub of the Wallowas, a summit with valleys radiating out in every direction.

hikes.name: Aneroid Lake
hikes.blurb: Up the East Fork Wallowa to an old cabin camp beside a lake under Aneroid and Pete's Point.

hikes.name: Slick Rock Creek Falls via Hurricane Creek
hikes.blurb: Up the Hurricane Creek valley under the Wallowas' white limestone walls to a falls sliding down a polished rock chute.

hikes.name: Sacajawea Peak
hikes.blurb: From Huricane Creek Trailhead, a 13.1-mile round trip to the top of Sacajawea Peak (9,810 ft), with about 5,050 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Legore Lake
hikes.blurb: From Huricane Creek Trailhead, a 6.7-mile round trip to Legore Lake, with about 4,200 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Dug Peak
hikes.blurb: From Huricane Creek Trailhead, a 4.8-mile round trip to the top of Dug Peak (8,577 ft), with about 3,500 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Sawtooth Peak
hikes.blurb: From Huricane Creek Trailhead, a 6.7-mile round trip to the top of Sawtooth Peak (9,149 ft), with about 4,100 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Twin Peaks
hikes.blurb: From Huricane Creek Trailhead, a 7.6-mile round trip to the top of Twin Peaks (9,655 ft), with about 4,850 feet of climbing.
